title: This Wandering Day
description: The Harfoots trek through marsh and woodland toward their autumn home. Nori teaches the Stranger his first words, among them 'friend' and 'peril'.

title: Three in white
description: Three pale figures arrive at the Stranger's crater and study the scorched ground. They are looking for him.

title: Wolves in the wood
description: Wolves fall on the stragglers. The Stranger drives them off with a blow that shakes the earth — and frightens Nori when the ice that heals his arm nearly takes hers.

title: Stand or kneel
description: Bronwyn asks the refugees to stay and fight; half of them follow Waldreg down the hill to Adar instead. Theo finally shows Arondir the hilt, and the Elf recognises it: a key, made to enslave the Southlands.

title: Only blood can bind
description: Waldreg hails Adar as Sauron and is beaten for the name. To prove his loyalty he is handed a knife and a boy from his own village.

title: Recruits for the expedition
description: Galadriel drills the volunteers in the square, one Elf against a dozen. Isildur, refused by his father, schemes for a place aboard; Halbrand insists he is staying in Númenor.

title: Fire in the harbour
description: Urged on by Eärien, Kemen slips aboard to burn the ships. Isildur, stowed away below, drags him out of the blaze and keeps his secret.

title: The song of the roots of Hithaeglir
description: Durin dines in Lindon. Afterwards Gil-galad tells Elrond the legend behind his interest — that mithril holds the light of a lost Silmaril — and the truth: the Elves are fading, and without it they must leave Middle-earth by spring.

title: Númenor sails to war
description: Halbrand takes up the kingship Galadriel offers him. Three ships leave the harbour for Middle-earth with the Queen Regent aboard.
